title: Slides and video from effector gene prediction webinar now available
summary: Slides and video from effector gene prediction webinar now available
bodyHtml: If you missed our recent webinar, which featured updates on the development of the Common Metabolic Diseases Knowledge Portal and a demonstration of effector gene predictions for T2D and 10 other traits, you can view the slides here and the video here. Please send us feedback on these features!
